Gavin — your /corporate-gifting page asks for an uploaded spreadsheet and says “We aim to reply within 2–3 working days.” That’s where 1.2% and the call/email leak live. Earn trust first (instant quote + reserve week), ask for the CSV second.

3 page fixes (fast, specific):
1) Hero that sells outcomes + reserves a week
   - Primary CTA: “Get instant quote (VAT itemised)”
   - Secondary CTA: “Reserve delivery week”
   - Keep your decision facts visible (your words): “Minimum order 20 gifts • Delivery windows 1 Nov–20 Dec • UK‑wide shipping • Lead time: 5–10 working days after payment • Branded note cards included • Multi‑address delivery via spreadsheet upload • Prices exclude VAT and courier.”

2) Instant quote (downloadable PDF)
   - Right‑side calculator: Gifts [ ] × Budget per gift [ ] → totals with a VAT line and a courier line.
   - Buttons: “Download quote (PDF)” and “Email me this quote.” Procurement box ticked before anyone calls.

3) Two‑step form (contact first; spreadsheet later)
   - Step 1 (short): Name, Company, Work email, Gift count, Budget band, Preferred delivery week.
   - Auto‑send the quote PDF + a link to pick a week on submit. Only then ask for the recipient CSV (or offer a template).
   - For paid sessions, push phone/email lower to reduce leaks; keep them prominent for organic.
   - Optional: link “Under 20 gifts? Shop curated bundles” to route small buyers.
